## Upstream changes 6.73.0 -> 6.74.0

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — no breaking changes in the notes, only deprecation warnings, new resources/data sources, enhancements and bug fixes.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none. There is no .env.example content to check (the file provided is empty), and nothing in the release notes names a Terraform variable, provider config key, or environment variable as renamed/removed/newly required.

### Data and dependencies
- No companion service (database, cache, search engine) versions are named in these notes.
- Several forward-looking deprecation warnings appear, worth tracking since a future provider version will start rejecting them: `data-source/aws_location_geofence_collection: Warn when kms_key_id is configured. The value has no effect, and a future version of the provider will reject it.`; `provider: Warn when tags_all is set in Plugin SDK V2 resource configurations. A future version of the provider will reject it.`; `provider: Warn when tags is set in data source configurations that don't filter by tags... A future version of the provider will reject it.`; `resource/aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream: Warn when arn is configured...`; `resource/aws_kinesis_stream: Warn when arn is configured...`; `resource/aws_rds_cluster: Warn when cluster_members is configured...`. None of these fail `terraform plan`/`apply` at 6.74.0, they only emit warnings.
- One behavioural change to note for any config touching S3 Object Lock: `resource/aws_s3_object: object_lock_retain_until_date is now Computed because Amazon S3 assigns and advances the value for objects under an event hold. Removing the argument from configuration no longer plans a change.` This only affects `aws_s3_object` resources under an event hold; not applicable to this EC2-focused template unless such a resource exists.
- Already true at 6.73.0 (not a change in this range, stated here only as baseline context): `resource/aws_efs_file_system: Until AWS roll out the service change supporting the new default encryption setting, changing encrypted = true to encrypted = false will seem to have succeeded without modifying anything on the AWS side.` This caveat was introduced in 6.73.0, the version the template already runs.

### Before applying
- None required by the notes. Normal practice still applies: run `terraform plan` after bumping the provider constraint and review the diff, particularly if any `aws_s3_object`, `aws_kinesis_stream`, `aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream`, or `aws_rds_cluster` resources are in use, to see the new deprecation warnings.
- The compose/provider pin in `01-providers.tf` reads `version = "~> 6.73.0"`, which constrains to the 6.73.x line and will **not** pick up 6.74.0 as-is. The pin itself must be edited (e.g. to `~> 6.74.0` or a broader `~> 6.73`) for this upgrade to take effect.

### Notes read
- v6.74.0 release notes (full)
- v6.73.0 release notes, read as the baseline only
- CHANGELOG.md excerpt covering 6.71.0 through 6.74.0, consulted for the same range
- Registry image comparison could not be read (401 Unauthorized) — container user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck and environment could not be cross-checked against the notes; verdict rests on the release notes alone.

## Upstream changes 8.19.25 -> 8.19.26

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — no content in the release notes for this version, the changelog points only to a generic reference page, and the image configurations are identical in every behaviour-relevant field.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes. The only content supplied for 8.19.26 is a title, a date, and a link to the reference-manual release notes page; no actual entries were provided to read.

### Variables
- none. `ZAMMAD_ELASTICSEARCH_IMAGE_VERSION=8.19.25` in `.env.example` and the compose pin both need updating to `8.19.26` to actually take this upgrade, but no variable is renamed, removed, or newly required.

### Data and dependencies
- none found in the notes for this range. (The compose file already runs Elasticsearch single-node with `xpack.security.enabled=false`, which is a pre-existing configuration, not something this upgrade introduces.)

### Before applying
- Update the pin: change `ZAMMAD_ELASTICSEARCH_IMAGE_VERSION`/the `elasticsearch` line in the compose `x-images` block from `8.19.25` to `8.19.26`, with the correct new digest.
- Since the actual release-note content for 8.19.26 was not provided (only the page title/link), check the linked page by hand before or shortly after applying: https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/8.19/release-notes-8.19.26.html
- No other manual steps indicated by what was supplied.

### Notes read
- `v8.19.26` (2026-11-23) — title/link only, no entries supplied.
- `v8.19.25` (2026-11-10), supplied as the "currently running" baseline — title/link only, no entries supplied.
- `v9.5.7` — unrelated major line, not applicable to this 8.19.x upgrade, not read further.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — contains no changelog entries, only a pointer to the reference-manual release notes page.
